dct_description_sm: The central question that this study is addressing is: What is the relationship between travel on sea ice and community health and safety in the Inuit community of Nain? The subquestions guiding data collection were as follows: (1) How do Inuit in Nain view the relationship between their use of the sea ice environment for travel and hunting and their health? (2) What are Inuit perspectives on hazards related to sea ice travel? (3) What are the social and environmental determinants that are influencing differing experiences of health impacts and benefits from using sea ice in the community of Nain? (4) How are incidents on the sea ice involving residents of Nain that require search and rescue assistance changing over time? (5) What is the role of search and rescue in promoting community health related to sea ice travel?
